jobs.text: Number two. Cutting into chicken to check it can let some of the juices escape, and guessing can leave it overcooked or undercooked. The T P nineteen H instant-read thermometer, sold under the Temp Pro name, formerly Thermo Pro, fixes that. Flip out the probe, and according to its manual, the backlit screen shows a reading in about three to four seconds. It's water resistant and has a magnet on the back.
